product_metadata.title: SUNNEST Curtain String Light Christmas, 300 LEDs 9.8FT x 9.8FT String Lights with 8 Lighting Modes, USB Powered Dimmable Hanging Lights with Remote for Indoor/Outdoor Wall Decoration
features: Blue Light with 8 Modes - Sequential, in waves, twinkle & marquee, double-light marquee, fade in and out, double-light fade in and out, twinkle, and steady on. Curtain string lights with 300LEDs create romantic ambience

2 Ways to Control Curtain lights - With the remote or the button on USB connector, you can choose different light effects, set timer, control power ON/OFF and adjust brightness. Easy to operate, convenient to use

Easy to Install/ Charge - 10 hooks make installation a breeze, just hang them on curtain rail. LED curtain lights with a USB plug can be powered by computer, power bank, etc. Easy charging for anywhere use

Durable & Reliable - Made of premium copper wires, LED wall lights features flexible, bendable and sturdy. Twinkle lights come with low voltage and low consumption, energy-saving and touchable for kids
Widely Use - 9.8FT x 9.8FT waterproof fairy string lights can cover most windows, curtains, walls or decorate outdoor wedding and party backdrop, pergola in the yard, shopping center, Christmas,etc.
description: Features: 8 Lighting Effects: fit different decorating themes. Adjustable Brightness: from strong to dim for diverse moods. Timer Function: makes it auto cycle through 6h on and 8h off. Memory Function: remember the settings when you turned off last time. USB Powered: easy to charge and can be used anywhere. 2 Control Options: easy to operate, in case of losing the remote. 300 LEDs: bring bright light, low consumption, saving energy. IP44 Waterproof: makes twinkle lights can stand snow and sprinkle. 9.8FT x 9.8FT: can cover larger areas for better decorating effect.  How to Install Hanging Lights? Step 1: unpack the package, connect to power and test the light effect. If it do not work, please contact us for help. Step 2: find the main string, and hang the hooks on curtain rails. Step 3: untie the 10 individual strings, and let them hang down. Step 4: turn on with remote or USB button, and enjoy gorgeous waterfall lights.  Warm Prompts: 1.Only curtain lights for bedroom, no curtains and no USB charger. 2.IP44 waterproof fairy lights can stand snow and sprinkle, but cannot be used on rainy days. 3.USB connector is not waterproof, so please keep it away from water. 4.Please do not untie the rope of strings until you have fix the main string of indoor string lights in case of tangling.  Specification Material: ABS + copper + epoxy Light Color: blue Waterproof Rate: IP44 Dimension: 9.8FT x 9.8 FT LED Quantity: 300 String Quantity: 10 Weight: 6oz Power Supply: USB plug Power: 5V 1A  Package Included: 1 x LED Curtain Light 1 x Remote Control (13 keys) 10 x Hooks 1 x User Manual
